name: Fix Spanish Province Names for WooCommerce
author: Anxo Sánchez

sections.description:
When WooCommerce is set to Spanish (Spain), some province names are displayed in their Castilianized form instead of their official names. This plugin restores the correct toponyms.

The following corrections are applied:

  • La Coruña → A Coruña
  • Orense → Ourense
  • Lérida → Lleida
  • Gerona → Girona

This plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. The corrections are applied automatically. No configuration needed.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, this plugin requires WooCommerce to be installed and activated.

Where are the corrections applied?

The corrections are applied wherever WooCommerce displays Spanish province names: checkout, my account, order details, etc.

Can I add more corrections?

Currently, the plugin only corrects the four provinces listed. If you need additional corrections, please open an issue on the plugin’s GitHub repository.
